text: Consider how different products might fulfill similar needs or wants for consumers and think about their relationship in terms of demand when prices change. Reflect on these options to determine which best describes goods that can be used interchangeably with one another.
Consider how substitutes affect demand when prices change for one good relative to another in your answer choices.

Goods like butter and margarine are often used interchangeably in recipes or as spreads on bread; think about what this relationship means for their demand when prices change relative to each other (Hint: One of these options describes goods that can replace the use of another).
